name: WF2 - Process one Drive lesson file

parameters.content:
## WF2 — one file → extract → upsert

Import **before WF1**. Leave **inactive**.

1. Download = **EF Google Drive** (`info@evergladesliteracy.org`).
2. Postgres = **EF Postgres** (port 5432, SSL Require).
3. OpenAI = **EF OpenAI**.
4. Confirm `lessons` exists (`n8n/schema.sql`).

Trigger accepts all JSON from WF1 (`id`, `name`, `mimeType`, `webViewLink`). Google Docs are converted to PDF on download.

values.content: You extract Everglades Literacy lesson metadata. Reply with JSON only using keys: summary (string), topics (string array), ngsss_standards (string array of codes like SC.2.L.17.2), fundamental_concept (string), grade_min (integer, PreK=-1, K=0), grade_max (integer), grade_range (string).

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO lessons (
  id, title, grade_range, grade_min, grade_max, topics, ngsss_standards,
  fundamental_concept, summary, lesson_url, pdf_url, drive_file_id,
  source_updated_at, indexed_at
) VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::text[], $7::text[],
  $8, $9, $10, $11, $12,
  NULLIF($13, '')::timestamptz, now()
)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  title = EXCLUDED.title,
  grade_range = EXCLUDED.grade_range,
  grade_min = EXCLUDED.grade_min,
  grade_max = EXCLUDED.grade_max,
  topics = EXCLUDED.topics,
  ngsss_standards = EXCLUDED.ngsss_standards,
  fundamental_concept = EXCLUDED.fundamental_concept,
  summary = EXCLUDED.summary,
  lesson_url = EXCLUDED.lesson_url,
  pdf_url = EXCLUDED.pdf_url,
  drive_file_id = EXCLUDED.drive_file_id,
  source_updated_at = EXCLUDED.source_updated_at,
  indexed_at = now();
